_comment: Input for `cli scm-setup`. Idempotent by name: existing objects are reported and left unchanged. 'parent' is the SCM name of the NGFW root folder ('All Firewalls' in the UI) - confirm with `cli scm-check`. Variable names get a leading '$' if missing. Snippet contents (rules, zones, routing) are not created here; build them in SCM or with the Terraform scm provider.
